answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks by binding each identity to a hardware-generated enclave key and an attested code measurement: MRENCLAVE in Intel SGX, with the analogous launch measurement in AMD SEV. Copying an image, VM, or atlas snapshot reproduces software but not the hardware-protected key and valid attestation on another platform; creating another identity therefore requires additional physical silicon, not virtual duplication. The ridge and grove nodes follow this rule.
